age.Description: Age of the participant at the first session.

sex.Description: Sex of the participant as reported by the participant.

handedness.Description: Handedness of the participant as reported by the participant.

tms_subject.Description: Whether this participant is part of the 35-subject sample the paper analyses. This is NOT the same as having received cTBS: sub-22 and sub-49 completed both cTBS sessions but are false here because they were excluded as behavioural outliers. To ask whether a participant was stimulated, look for ses-2/ses-3 rows in sub-<label>/sub-<label>_sessions.tsv instead.

Levels.true: Completed both cTBS sessions and is included in the reported analyses.
Levels.false: Session 1 only, or a cTBS participant excluded as a behavioural outlier.
